title: Chatterbox TTS on AMD ROCm (7900 XTX): torchcodec has no ROCm support, here's the fix
body: I spent hours working on this today and thought the resolution might help some other AMD people in the future. Got Chatterbox TTS (the Extended fork by petermg, has auto chunking for long text) running on an AMD 7900 XTX with ROCm 7.2. Hit two AMD-specific walls that took a while to track down, posting in case it saves someone else the time. Setup: Ubuntu 24.04, ROCm 7.2.1, gfx1100 (7900 XTX), torch installed via the
